output:
Hi Mum, Kirsty and Linda,

I’ve got a wee surprise planned for Gran’s 80th! Morag has kindly let me have Hair by Morag to myself on Saturday 12 December, from 1pm. I’d love to do everyone’s hair for free before we head out for Gran’s birthday dinner the next day. Gran doesn’t know, so please keep it quiet!

There are seven heads to sort: me, the three of you, Gran, and Ava and Ruby. A cut and blow-dry is absolutely fine for everyone. If you fancy a colour as well, just let me know what you’d like by Friday 27 November so I can order the supplies in time. Gran mentioned at Easter that she’d love to go properly silver, so I could help her with that too if she’s still keen. No pressure, though—we’ll see what’s doable.

Ava and Ruby can have wee braids and glitter spray, which I’m sure they’ll love. And Linda, I promise I’ll keep the colour well away from the cooker and the dog this time!

Mum, could you get Gran to the salon for 1pm without letting on what’s happening? You’re probably the best person to manage that. The salon’s on Dumbarton Road, as you all know.

We’ve got dinner booked for 8.30pm on Saturday at the Italian on Byres Road, with Uncle Davie and Kirsty’s man joining us, so there should be plenty of time to get ready and head over. Morag says we can bring a bottle of fizz, as long as we tidy up after ourselves.

Let me know what you’re thinking for your hair, especially any colours, by the 27th. I’m so excited to do this for Gran!

Lots of love,

[Your name]
